query:
SELECT t.id AS "technique_id!: i64",
                  t.name AS technique_name,
                  th.id AS "thread_id!: i64"
           FROM threads th
           JOIN techniques t ON t.id = th.technique_id
           WHERE th.anchor_kind = 'camp_technique'
             AND th.camp_id = ?
             AND th.deleted_at IS NULL
             AND lower(t.name) LIKE ?
           ORDER BY t.name
           LIMIT ?
